verdict.rationale: Greenhouse's first-party docs describe a built-in Notetaker that records and transcribes interviews and maps AI-generated notes and summaries directly to scorecard questions, which covers the core of the story. The evidence never mentions how candidate consent to recording is captured or managed, and that is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: documented candidate consent handling for recording, independent or hands-on corroboration of Notetaker quality.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: Greenhouse Notetaker automatically records and transcribes interviews, then instantly maps AI-generated notes directly to scorecard questions
AI summaries are mapped to scorecard questions, reducing time to submission and dramatically increasing completion.
Replace standalone recording and notetaking tools with functionality built directly in Greenhouse. No extension, no third-party login, no data silos.
